title: campanula rapunculoides var. lunariifolia
intro: Campanula rapunculoides var. lunariifolia, commonly known as the Creeping Bellflower or Alpine Bellflower, is a perennial flowering plant in the family Campanulaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which may aid in relaxing the muscles and reducing stress. The bioactive constituents of Campanula rapunculoides var. lunariifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
